text: Release wheels carry stale files from a reused setuptools build/ dir

Fixed in 47e54c3 with ./build-wheel.sh (repo root, alongside verify-all.sh)
rather than docs alone — "remember to clean build/ first" had already been missed
twice.

The script removes server/build + server/dist, builds, then verifies the result:
web_dist/assets must match index.html's references in BOTH directions (an extra
file is exactly the stale-build symptom; a missing one is a broken bundle), plus
schema.sql, migrations.py, templates/invite.html and the APK must be present.
Confirmed it catches the real bug by planting a stale index-OLDHASH.js: the build
fails naming the offending file, exit 1.

READMEs updated: server/README.md now documents the script instead of a bare
`python -m build --wheel` and explains why; the root README's Versioning section
gained the end-to-end release sequence, which wasn't written down anywhere before.

Did NOT go further and make it rebuild web_dist/the APK — those are committed
inputs with much slower toolchains, and folding them in would make a server-only
release needlessly expensive. The root README covers when to rebuild them.

NOT released — user asked to hold this for the next batch.
